repo_notes.content: Swift package SplitflapKit: split-flap departure-board text for SwiftUI (Splitflap view with splitflap… modifiers) and UIKit (SplitflapView), iOS, iPadOS and Mac Catalyst. Sources/SplitflapPlanner is a pure-Swift planner ported line by line from react-native-splitflap's TypeScript planner and tested against its golden plans (Tests/SplitflapPlannerTests/Resources). Sources/SplitflapKit holds the Core Animation player (glyph atlas, keyframe tracks, drum/flip/scramble renderers, retargeting from presentation layers), measurement with natural and uniform widths (and the dense default of flip and scramble) and … truncation, and the SwiftUI wrapper. Examples/SplitflapDemo is a demo app generated by XcodeGen.
